parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A single turned wooden leg of the table, cylindrical and decorative in shape.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the tabletop and structure.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A second wooden leg identical to the first, part of the table’s support structure.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the tabletop and maintains balance.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A third wooden leg of the table, turned and decorative.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A fourth wooden leg completing the table’s support system.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the tabletop and connects to stretchers for rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A rectangular wooden drawer located under the tabletop.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items such as stationery or utensils.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out horizontally along rails.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting two legs near the base.
parts.Functional_description: Provides lateral stability and prevents wobbling.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher
parts.Basic_description: A second horizontal wooden bar connecting another pair of legs.
parts.Functional_description: Adds structural rigidity to the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher
parts.Basic_description: A third horizontal wooden bar forming part of the lower frame.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher
parts.Basic_description: A fourth horizontal wooden bar completing the stretcher frame.
parts.Functional_description: Provides cross-bracing and prevents leg splaying.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Tabletop Connector
parts.Basic_description: A wooden connector piece joining the tabletop to the frame.
parts.Functional_description: Secures the tabletop to the leg assembly.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Tabletop Connector
parts.Basic_description: A second connector piece supporting the tabletop structure.
parts.Functional_description: Distributes load from the tabletop to the legs.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Tabletop Connector
parts.Basic_description: A third connector piece located under the tabletop.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Tabletop Connector
parts.Basic_description: A fourth connector piece completing the tabletop support frame.
parts.Functional_description: Ensures even load distribution and stability.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A flat rectangular wooden surface forming the top of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides the main working or placing surface for objects.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed; does not move during normal use.
